title: CI skeleton and make check gate
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Quality gate
  Scenario: make check runs local gates
    Given the repository is checked out with dependencies installed
    When a developer runs make check
    Then Python lint, TypeScript lint, unit tests, embed build, and CDK synth are invoked
```

## Implementation brief
1. Root Makefile with check target.
2. .github/workflows/ci.yml: lint/test on PRs to develop.
3. Acceptance: workflow file exists; make check is documented in README.
